geopolitical.note: Market-transmitted proxy (VIX + credit + safe-haven USD); GPR index not available. Separate from the recession composite.

indicators.name: Yield Curve 10Y-3M
indicators.description: Spread between 10Y and 3M Treasury yields. Inversion historically precedes recession by 6–18 months.

indicators.name: Yield Curve 10Y-2Y
indicators.description: Spread between 10Y and 2Y Treasury yields. Classic recession signal.

indicators.name: Baa-10Y Credit Spread
indicators.description: Corporate spread as a credit-stress proxy. Threshold calibrated to widening regimes.

indicators.name: Chicago Fed NFCI
indicators.description: Broad financial conditions index. Positive = tighter than average.

indicators.name: VIX (Equity Vol)
indicators.description: CBOE volatility index. Sustained levels above 25 indicate market stress.

indicators.name: High Yield Spread
indicators.description: ICE BofA US high-yield option-adjusted spread. Above 5% = elevated credit risk.

indicators.name: 10Y TIPS Breakeven
indicators.description: Market-implied 10-year inflation expectations; collapse signals deflation/growth fears.

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.description: Federal Reserve total assets; QT (shrinking) tightens financial conditions.

indicators.name: M2 Money Supply
indicators.description: M2 money supply; sharp deceleration signals tightening liquidity and recession risk.

indicators.name: St. Louis Financial Stress
indicators.description: St. Louis Fed Financial Stress Index (v4; replaces discontinued STLFSI3). Zero = average; above zero = above-average stress.

indicators.name: Chicago Fed Activity Index
indicators.description: Chicago Fed National Activity Index (replaces discontinued USSLIND). Weighted average of 85 indicators; sustained readings below zero signal below-trend growth, below -0.7 historically coincides with recession.

indicators.name: Economic Policy Uncertainty
indicators.description: US Economic Policy Uncertainty Index. Elevated uncertainty suppresses investment and hiring; spikes precede economic slowdowns.

indicators.name: Unemployment Rate
indicators.description: Headline U3 unemployment. Z-score normalized.

indicators.name: Sahm Rule (Real-Time)
indicators.description: Triggers at 0.5 when unemployment 3mo avg rises 0.5pp above its 12mo low. Historically coincident with recession start.

indicators.name: Initial Jobless Claims
indicators.description: Fast labor deterioration signal. Threshold = sustained recessionary level.

indicators.name: Payroll Employment
indicators.description: Nonfarm payroll trend. Z-score normalized.

indicators.name: JOLTS Quits Rate
indicators.description: Worker confidence proxy. Falling quits = labor market cooling.

indicators.name: UMich Consumer Sentiment
indicators.description: University of Michigan Consumer Sentiment Index; forward-looking consumer health.

indicators.name: Labor Force Participation Rate
indicators.description: Civilian labor force participation rate; declining LFPR signals discouraged workers exiting.

indicators.name: CPI All Items YoY
indicators.description: Headline CPI. Z-score normalized over trailing window.

indicators.name: Core CPI YoY
indicators.description: Core CPI (ex food/energy). Z-score normalized.

indicators.name: PCE Price Index
indicators.description: Fed's preferred inflation measure. Z-score normalized.

indicators.name: Fed Funds Rate
indicators.description: Policy rate level. Z-score normalized.

indicators.name: Avg Hourly Earnings
indicators.description: Wage pressure signal. Z-score normalized.

indicators.name: Real GDP
indicators.description: Real output. Z-score on QoQ change.

indicators.name: Industrial Production
indicators.description: Goods-sector output. Z-score normalized.

indicators.name: Retail Sales
indicators.description: Consumer demand. Z-score normalized.

indicators.name: Real Income ex Transfers
indicators.description: Earned household income. NBER coincident series.

indicators.name: Housing Starts
indicators.description: Rate-sensitive leading housing signal.

indicators.name: Weekly Economic Index
indicators.description: NY Fed Weekly Economic Index; 10 daily/weekly indicators scaled to match YoY GDP growth.

indicators.name: Personal Saving Rate
indicators.description: Personal saving as % of disposable income; higher = more consumer buffer.

indicators.name: Case-Shiller Home Price Index
indicators.description: S&P/Case-Shiller national home price index; housing wealth leads consumer spending 6–12 months.

indicators.name: Capacity Utilization
indicators.description: Total industry capacity utilization; below 78% signals slowing investment and industrial contraction.

indicators.name: Building Permits
indicators.description: New privately-owned housing units authorized. Leads construction by 1–2 months; sharp declines precede recessions.

indicators.name: 30-Year Fixed Mortgage Rate
indicators.description: 30-year fixed mortgage rate; rising rates directly reduce housing affordability and construction, leading the real economy by 6–12 months.

indicators.name: Manufacturers New Orders
indicators.description: Census new orders for nondefense capital goods ex aircraft. Goods-sector demand proxy.

indicators.name: Bank Lending Standards (C&I)
indicators.description: Net % of banks tightening C&I loan standards (Senior Loan Officer Survey).

indicators.name: Consumer Credit Delinquency
indicators.description: Credit card delinquency rate at all commercial banks. Household stress gauge.

indicators.name: JOLTS Job Openings
indicators.description: Employer demand (FRED: thousands). 5,500 = 5.5M openings, near recessionary trough.

indicators.name: PPI All Commodities
indicators.description: Producer Price Index for all commodities; rising PPI compresses margins and signals cost-push stress.

indicators.name: G7 Leading Indicator
indicators.description: OECD Composite Leading Indicator for the G7. Below 100 signals below-trend global growth.

indicators.name: Euro Area Yield Curve
indicators.description: Derived: Euro area 10Y govt yield minus 3M rate. Inversion = EU recession signal.

indicators.name: Euro Area Unemployment
indicators.description: Euro area harmonized unemployment rate. Z-score normalized.

indicators.name: Euro Area Real GDP
indicators.description: Euro area real GDP, chained 2010 EUR, ECB/Eurostat. Z-score normalized.

indicators.name: Trade-Weighted USD
indicators.description: Nominal broad trade-weighted US dollar index. A stronger dollar tightens global financial conditions and pressures EM economies.
